hook.en: Your body is yours. You should feel safe in it, always.
hook.hg: Tumhara body tumhara hai. Isme tumhe hamesha safe feel hona chahiye.

objectives.en: Tell a safe touch from an unsafe touch.
objectives.hg: Safe touch aur unsafe touch ka farak pehchanna.

objectives.en: Know which parts of the body are private.
objectives.hg: Jaanna ki body ke kaun se parts private hain.

objectives.en: Remember the three steps: No, Go, Tell.
objectives.hg: Teen steps yaad rakhna: No bolo, Go karo, Tell karo.

body.en: Your body is yours. You can say how you like to be touched. A hug from Mummy can feel warm and nice. But if you do not want a hug or a kiss, you can say, 'No, thank you.' Even to a grown-up. Even to someone you love. Saying no is not rude.
body.hg: Tumhara body tumhara hai. Tum bata sakte ho ki tumhe kaise touch kiya jaana achha lagta hai. Mummy ka hug pyaara lag sakta hai. Lekin agar tumhe hug ya kissi nahi chahiye, toh tum bol sakte ho, 'No, thank you.' Kisi bade se bhi. Jisse tum pyaar karte ho, usse bhi. Na bolna badtameezi nahi hai.

body.en: The parts covered by your underwear, and your chest, are private parts. They have real names, like penis, vulva and bottom. Nobody should touch them, look at them, show you theirs or ask you to touch theirs. Mummy or Papa may help you bathe, or a doctor may check you with your parent there. That is never a secret.
body.hg: Body ke jo parts underwear se dhake rehte hain, woh private parts hain. Tumhari chest bhi private hai. Inke asli naam hote hain, jaise penis, vulva aur bottom. Koi inhe na chhue, na dekhe, na apne private parts tumhe dikhaye, na tumse apne private parts chhoone ko bole. Mummy ya Papa nahane mein help kar sakte hain, ya doctor Mummy-Papa ke saamne check kar sakte hain. Yeh kabhi secret nahi hota.

body.en: A safe touch makes you feel cared for, like holding Papa's hand on the road or a high-five from a friend. An unsafe touch hurts you, scares you or makes your tummy feel funny. A touch on your private parts is unsafe. A touch that someone wants to keep secret is unsafe too.
body.hg: Safe touch se lagta hai ki koi tumhara khayal rakh raha hai, jaise road par Papa ka haath pakadna ya dost ka high-five. Unsafe touch se dard hota hai, darr lagta hai ya pet mein ajeeb sa lagta hai. Private parts ko chhuna unsafe touch hai. Jis touch ko koi secret rakhna chahe, woh bhi unsafe hai.

body.en: If a touch feels unsafe, do three things. NO: say 'No!' or 'Stop!' in a big voice. GO: move away to where other people are. TELL: tell a grown-up you trust what happened. If you could not say no or run, that is okay. You can still tell. It is never your fault.
body.hg: Agar koi touch unsafe lage, toh teen kaam karo. NO: zor se bolo 'Nahi!' ya 'Stop!' GO: wahan chale jao jahan aur log hon. TELL: kisi trusted bade ko batao ki kya hua. Agar tum no nahi bol paaye ya bhaag nahi paaye, toh bhi koi baat nahi. Tum tab bhi bata sakte ho. Galti kabhi tumhari nahi hoti.

claim.en: I must always let grown-ups hug or touch me, or I am a bad child.
claim.hg: Mujhe hamesha bado ko hug ya touch karne dena chahiye, warna main bura bachcha hoon.

fact.en: You are not bad for saying no. Your body is yours, and caring grown-ups listen when you say stop.
fact.hg: No bolne se tum bure nahi ban jaate. Tumhara body tumhara hai, aur caring bade 'stop' sunkar ruk jaate hain.

takeaways.en: My body belongs to me, and I can say no to a touch I do not want.
takeaways.hg: Mera body mera hai, aur jo touch mujhe nahi chahiye use no bolna mera haq hai.

takeaways.en: Private parts are private, and a touch that must be kept secret is unsafe.
takeaways.hg: Private parts private hain, aur jis touch ko secret rakhna pade woh unsafe hai.

takeaways.en: If a touch feels unsafe I say No, Go away and Tell a trusted grown-up, and it is never my fault.
takeaways.hg: Unsafe touch ho toh mujhe No bolna hai, Go karna hai aur trusted bade ko Tell karna hai, aur galti kabhi meri nahi hoti.

activity.en: Stand in front of a mirror and practise saying 'No! Stop!' in your big, strong voice three times. Then show a grown-up you trust how strong your voice is.
activity.hg: Mirror ke saamne khade hokar apni badi, strong awaaz mein teen baar bolo 'No! Stop!' Phir kisi trusted bade ko dikhao ki tumhari awaaz kitni strong hai.

q.en: Which parts of your body are private?
q.hg: Tumhare body ke kaun se parts private hain?

options.en: My hands and feet
options.hg: Mere haath aur pair

options.en: The parts covered by my underwear, and my chest
options.hg: Underwear se dhake parts aur meri chest

options.en: My hair and ears
options.hg: Mere baal aur kaan

explain.en: The parts under your underwear and your chest are private. Only Mummy or Papa helping you bathe, or a doctor with your parent there, may touch them to keep you clean or healthy. That is never a secret.
explain.hg: Underwear ke neeche ke parts aur chest private hain. Sirf nahane mein help karte time Mummy ya Papa, ya Mummy-Papa ke saamne doctor, tumhe saaf ya healthy rakhne ke liye inhe chhoo sakte hain. Yeh kabhi secret nahi hota.

q.en: If a touch feels unsafe, I can say NO even to a grown-up I know.
q.hg: Agar koi touch unsafe lage, toh jaan-pehchaan ke bade ko bhi NO bolna mera haq hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Yes. Your body is yours, so you can say no to anyone, and then go and tell a trusted grown-up.
explain.hg: Haan. Tumhara body tumhara hai, isliye tum kisi ko bhi no bol sakte ho, aur phir jaakar trusted bade ko bata sakte ho.

warning.en: If anyone has touched you in an unsafe way, tell a grown-up you trust. A grown-up or you can call Child Helpline 1098 at any time. It is free.
warning.hg: Agar kisi ne tumhe unsafe tareeke se touch kiya hai, toh kisi trusted bade ko batao. Tum ya koi bada kabhi bhi Child Helpline 1098 par call kar sakte ho. Yeh free hai.

hook.en: Some secrets are fun. Some secrets feel heavy. Heavy secrets are for telling.
hook.hg: Kuch secrets fun hote hain. Kuch secrets heavy lagte hain. Heavy secrets batane ke liye hote hain.

objectives.en: Tell a safe secret from an unsafe secret.
objectives.hg: Safe secret aur unsafe secret ka farak samajhna.

objectives.en: Name five grown-ups you trust.
objectives.hg: Apne paanch trusted bado ke naam batana.

objectives.en: Know what to do about bullying.
objectives.hg: Jaanna ki bullying hone par kya karna hai.

body.en: A safe secret is a happy surprise, like a birthday gift for Dadi. Everyone finds out soon and feels happy. An unsafe secret makes you feel scared, sad or mixed up. It may be about a touch, a photo or a gift. Someone may say, 'Don't tell anyone, ever.' Never keep an unsafe secret. Tell a grown-up you trust.
body.hg: Safe secret ek happy surprise hota hai, jaise Dadi ke birthday ka gift. Jaldi hi sabko pata chal jaata hai aur sab khush hote hain. Unsafe secret se darr, udaasi ya confusion hoti hai. Woh kisi touch, photo ya gift ke baare mein ho sakta hai. Koi bol sakta hai, 'Kisi ko kabhi mat batana.' Unsafe secret kabhi mat rakho. Kisi trusted bade ko bata do.

body.en: A trusted grown-up listens to you, believes you and keeps you safe. It can be Mummy, Papa, Nani, a teacher or an aunty you like. Hold up your hand. For each finger, pick one trusted grown-up. Try to pick some at home and some at school. These five are your helpers.
body.hg: Trusted bada woh hai jo tumhari baat sunta hai, tum par yakeen karta hai aur tumhe safe rakhta hai. Woh Mummy, Papa, Nani, teacher ya koi favourite aunty ho sakti hain. Apna haath uthao. Har ungli ke liye ek trusted bada chuno. Kuch ghar se chuno aur kuch school se. Yeh paanch tumhare helpers hain.

h.hg: Batate raho, jab tak koi help na kare

body.en: Sometimes a grown-up is busy or does not understand. That does not mean you were wrong. Go to the next helper on your hand and tell again. Keep telling until someone listens and helps. If anyone says you will get in trouble for telling, that is a trick. You will not be in trouble. Telling is brave.
body.hg: Kabhi-kabhi bade busy hote hain ya samajh nahi paate. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki tum galat the. Apne haath ke agle helper ke paas jao aur phir se batao. Tab tak batate raho jab tak koi sunkar help na kare. Agar koi bole ki batane par tumhe daant padegi, toh woh ek trick hai. Tumhe daant nahi padegi. Batana bahaduri hai.

body.en: Bullying is when someone hurts you again and again on purpose. They may push you, call you names, take your tiffin or leave you out of games. It is not your fault. Do not hit back. Tell your teacher and a grown-up at home. If you see bullying, be kind to that child and tell a grown-up.
body.hg: Bullying tab hoti hai jab koi jaan-boojhkar tumhe baar-baar hurt karta hai. Woh dhakka de sakta hai, gande naam se bula sakta hai, tumhara tiffin chheen sakta hai ya tumhe games se bahar rakh sakta hai. Yeh tumhari galti nahi hai. Palatkar maaro mat. Apni teacher ko aur ghar par kisi bade ko batao. Agar kisi aur ke saath bullying hote dekho, toh us bachche ke saath kind raho aur kisi bade ko batao.

claim.hg: Bado ko batana chugli karna hai.

fact.en: Telling to keep yourself or a friend safe is not tattling. It is asking for help, and it is always the right thing to do.
fact.hg: Khud ko ya dost ko safe rakhne ke liye batana chugli nahi hai. Yeh help maangna hai, aur yeh hamesha sahi kaam hai.

takeaways.en: Happy surprises are safe secrets, but a secret that feels scary must be told.
takeaways.hg: Happy surprises safe secrets hain, lekin darane wala secret batana zaroori hai.

takeaways.en: I have five trusted grown-ups, and I keep telling until one of them helps.
takeaways.hg: Mere paanch trusted bade hain, aur jab tak koi help na kare, mujhe batate rehna hai.

takeaways.en: Bullying is never my fault, and telling a grown-up about it is brave.
takeaways.hg: Bullying kabhi meri galti nahi hai, aur iske baare mein bado ko batana bahaduri hai.

activity.en: Trace your hand on a sheet of paper. On each finger, write or draw one grown-up you trust. Keep the paper where you can see it.
activity.hg: Ek paper par apne haath ka outline banao. Har ungli par ek trusted bade ka naam likho ya drawing banao. Paper ko aisi jagah rakho jahan woh tumhe dikhta rahe.

q.en: An older boy in your building says, 'Come and play a secret game. If you tell, Mummy will scold you.' What do you do?
q.hg: Building ka ek bada ladka bolta hai, 'Chalo ek secret game khelte hain. Bataoge toh Mummy daantengi.' Tum kya karoge?

options.en: Say no, go away and tell a trusted grown-up
options.hg: No bolna, wahan se hat jaana aur trusted bade ko batana

options.en: Keep the secret so Mummy does not get angry
options.hg: Secret rakhna taaki Mummy naraaz na hon

options.en: Play the game just one time
options.hg: Bas ek baar game khel lena

explain.en: A secret that comes with a threat is an unsafe secret. No, Go, Tell keeps you safe, and you will not be in trouble for telling.
explain.hg: Jis secret ke saath dhamki ho, woh unsafe secret hai. No, Go, Tell tumhe safe rakhta hai, aur batane par tumhe daant nahi padegi.

q.en: If the first grown-up does not listen, I should stop telling.
q.hg: Agar pehla bada meri baat na sune, toh mujhe batana band kar dena chahiye.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Go to the next trusted grown-up and tell again. Keep telling until someone helps you.
explain.hg: Agle trusted bade ke paas jao aur phir batao. Tab tak batate raho jab tak koi help na kare.

subtitle.en: Spot it early, speak up early

hook.en: Not every unsafe person looks scary. Some bring chocolates. Learn the patterns, not the faces.
hook.hg: Har unsafe insaan scary nahi dikhta. Kuch chocolate lekar aate hain. Chehre nahi, pattern pehchanna seekho.

objectives.en: Recognise the four kinds of bullying, including online bullying.
objectives.hg: Bullying ke chaar types pehchanna, online bullying bhi.

objectives.en: Tell friendly joking from harassment.
objectives.hg: Friendly mazaak aur harassment ka farak samajhna.

objectives.en: Spot the warning signs of grooming and know who to tell.
objectives.hg: Grooming ke warning signs pehchanna aur jaanna ki kisko batana hai.

body.en: Bullying is hurting someone on purpose, again and again, when they find it hard to make it stop. It can be physical, like hitting, pushing or breaking your things. It can be verbal, like name-calling about your body, skin colour, caste, religion, marks or the way you talk. It can be social, like spreading rumours or making sure nobody sits with you. And it can be online, like mean group chats or edited photos. All four hurt. None of them is 'just fun' if one person is not laughing.
body.hg: Bullying ka matlab hai kisi ko jaan-boojhkar, baar-baar hurt karna, jab uske liye ise rokna mushkil ho. Yeh physical ho sakti hai, jaise maarna, dhakka dena ya saamaan todna. Yeh verbal ho sakti hai, jaise body, skin colour, caste, religion, marks ya bolne ke style par naam rakhna. Yeh social ho sakti hai, jaise rumours failana ya aisa karna ki koi tumhare saath na baithe. Aur yeh online ho sakti hai, jaise mean group chats ya edited photos. Chaaron hurt karti hain. Agar ek banda hans nahi raha, toh woh 'bas masti' nahi hai.

h.hg: Jab teasing harassment ban jaati hai

body.en: Friends joke with each other, both sides laugh, and either one can say stop. It becomes harassment when it is unwanted and keeps going. Comments about someone's body or how it is changing, pulling at a bra strap or pants, staring, blocking the way, forcing a hug or touching without permission are harassment, not masti. It can happen to girls, boys and every child. You never have to laugh along. Say 'Stop, I don't like it', move away and tell a teacher or parent. The person doing it is responsible, not you.
body.hg: Dost aapas mein mazaak karte hain, dono hanste hain, aur koi bhi 'bas' bol sakta hai. Jab koi cheez unwanted ho aur phir bhi chalti rahe, toh woh harassment ban jaati hai. Kisi ki body ya usme ho rahe changes par comment karna, bra strap ya pant kheenchna, ghoorna, raasta rokna, zabardasti hug karna ya bina permission touch karna harassment hai, masti nahi. Yeh ladkiyon, ladkon aur har bachche ke saath ho sakta hai. Tumhe saath mein hansne ki koi zaroorat nahi. Bolo 'Stop, mujhe yeh pasand nahi', wahan se hat jao aur teacher ya parents ko batao. Responsible wahi hai jo aisa kar raha hai, tum nahi.

h.en: Grooming: how tricky people build trust
h.hg: Grooming: tricky log trust kaise banate hain

body.en: Grooming is when an older person slowly wins a child's trust so that they can harm the child later. It often starts nicely: extra attention, gifts, chocolates, game recharges, telling you that you are 'more mature than the others'. Then come small tests: little secrets, private chats, asking to meet alone, touching that 'accidentally' crosses a line, or making you feel you owe them. Usually it is someone the child knows, such as a relative, neighbour, tutor, coach or older student, and sometimes an online 'friend'. The pattern is the warning: special favours, plus secrecy, plus time alone.
body.hg: Grooming tab hoti hai jab koi bada insaan dheere-dheere bachche ka trust jeetta hai, taaki baad mein use harm kar sake. Shuruaat aksar achhi lagti hai: extra attention, gifts, chocolates, game recharge, yeh bolna ki tum 'baakiyon se zyada mature' ho. Phir chhote-chhote tests aate hain: chhote secrets, private chats, akele milne ko bolna, 'galti se' line cross karne wala touch, ya yeh feel karana ki tum par unka ehsaan hai. Usually yeh koi jaan-pehchaan wala hota hai, jaise rishtedaar, padosi, tuition teacher, coach ya senior student, aur kabhi-kabhi koi online 'friend'. Warning isi pattern mein hai: special favours, plus secrecy, plus akele mein time.

body.en: If something feels off, you do not need proof and you do not need to be sure. Tell a trusted adult exactly what happened and how it made you feel. If the first adult brushes it off, tell another one. You can call Child Helpline 1098 free, at any time of day, and in an emergency call 112. If you see someone being bullied, do not join in or film it. Sit with them, tell them it is not their fault and take it to a teacher. Whatever happened, the blame belongs to the person who did it.
body.hg: Agar kuch off lage, toh tumhe proof ki zaroorat nahi aur sure hone ki bhi zaroorat nahi. Kisi trusted adult ko saaf-saaf batao ki kya hua aur tumhe kaisa laga. Agar pehla adult baat taal de, toh kisi doosre ko batao. Tum Child Helpline 1098 par din-raat kabhi bhi free call kar sakte ho, aur emergency mein 112 par call karo. Agar kisi ke saath bullying hote dekho, toh usme join mat karo aur video mat banao. Uske paas baitho, use batao ki yeh uski galti nahi hai, aur baat teacher tak le jao. Jo bhi hua ho, blame usi ka hai jisne aisa kiya.

claim.en: If I took the gifts or kept the secret earlier, I cannot complain now.
claim.hg: Agar maine pehle gifts le liye ya secret rakh liya, toh ab complain karne ka mujhe koi haq nahi.

fact.en: Tricky people give gifts and ask for secrets exactly so that a child feels stuck. Taking a gift or staying quiet earlier never makes the harm your fault, and you can tell at any time.
fact.hg: Tricky log gifts isiliye dete hain aur secrets isiliye rakhwate hain ki bachcha khud ko stuck feel kare. Pehle gift lene ya chup rehne se harm tumhari galti nahi ban jaata, aur tum kabhi bhi bata sakte ho.

takeaways.en: Bullying can be physical, verbal, social or online, and it is never the target's fault.
takeaways.hg: Bullying physical, verbal, social ya online ho sakti hai, aur yeh kabhi uski galti nahi hoti jiske saath ho rahi hai.

takeaways.en: Unwanted comments or touching are harassment, even when someone calls them a joke.
takeaways.hg: Unwanted comments ya touching harassment hai, chahe koi use mazaak bole.

takeaways.en: Special favours plus secrecy plus time alone is a grooming warning sign, so tell a trusted adult or call 1098.
takeaways.hg: Special favours plus secrecy plus akele mein time grooming ka warning sign hai, isliye trusted adult ko batao ya 1098 par call karo.

activity.en: In a private notebook, write the names of three adults you could tell if something felt wrong, and one sentence you could start with, such as 'Something happened and I need your help.'
activity.hg: Apni private notebook mein aise teen adults ke naam likho jinhe tum kuch galat lagne par bata sako, aur ek line likho jisse tum baat start kar sako, jaise 'Kuch hua hai aur mujhe aapki help chahiye.'

q.en: Which of these is a warning sign of grooming?
q.hg: Inme se kaun sa grooming ka warning sign hai?

options.en: A coach praises the whole team after a match
options.hg: Coach match ke baad poori team ki tareef karte hain

options.en: A teacher asks your parents to come for a meeting
options.hg: Teacher tumhare parents ko meeting ke liye bulati hain

options.en: A tutor gives only you gifts and says to keep your chats secret
options.hg: Tutor sirf tumhe gifts dete hain aur chats secret rakhne ko bolte hain

options.en: An uncle says hello to you at a family function
options.hg: Ek uncle family function mein tumhe hello bolte hain

explain.en: Special gifts for one child combined with secrecy is a classic grooming pattern. Safe adults do not need secrets from your parents.
explain.hg: Sirf ek bachche ko special gifts aur saath mein secrecy grooming ka classic pattern hai. Safe adults ko tumhare parents se kuch chhupane ki zaroorat nahi hoti.

q.en: It only counts as bullying if someone is hit or pushed.
q.hg: Bullying tabhi count hoti hai jab kisi ko maara ya dhakka diya jaye.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Name-calling, rumours, leaving someone out and cruel messages online are bullying too, and they can hurt just as much.
explain.hg: Naam rakhna, rumours failana, kisi ko left out karna aur online cruel messages bhi bullying hai, aur yeh bhi utna hi hurt kar sakte hain.

warning.en: If an older person asks you for secrets, private meetings or touches you in ways you do not like, tell a trusted adult today or call 1098.
warning.hg: Agar koi bada insaan tumse secrets rakhne ko bole, akele milne ko bole ya aise touch kare jo tumhe pasand na ho, toh aaj hi kisi trusted adult ko batao ya 1098 par call karo.

title.en: Harassment, Grooming and Stalking: Call It What It Is
title.hg: Harassment, Grooming aur Stalking: Jo Hai Wahi Bolo

subtitle.en: Names, patterns and the law on your side
subtitle.hg: Sahi naam, patterns aur tumhari side wala kanoon

hook.en: 'Eve-teasing' sounds harmless. The real name is sexual harassment, and it is an offence.
hook.hg: 'Eve-teasing' sunne mein harmless lagta hai. Iska asli naam sexual harassment hai, aur yeh offence hai.

objectives.en: Identify sexual harassment in its verbal, non-verbal, physical and online forms.
objectives.hg: Sexual harassment ke verbal, non-verbal, physical aur online forms pehchanna.

objectives.en: Explain how grooming and abuse by trusted people work.
objectives.hg: Samjhana ki grooming aur trusted logon dwara abuse kaise hota hai.

objectives.en: Describe stalking and what POCSO says about people under 18.
objectives.hg: Batana ki stalking kya hai aur POCSO 18 se kam umar walon ke baare mein kya kehta hai.

body.en: Sexual harassment is any unwelcome behaviour of a sexual nature. Verbal: comments about your body, sexual jokes, rating people, repeated requests after a no. Non-verbal: staring at body parts, whistling, obscene gestures, showing sexual images. Physical: brushing against you on purpose, groping, pinching, forced hugs. Online: sexual messages, unwanted pictures, demands for photos. It happens on buses, in schools, tuitions, families and DMs. The test is not what the other person says they meant. The test is whether it was unwanted. Calling it 'eve-teasing' or 'mazaak' hides what it is.
body.hg: Sexual harassment ka matlab hai sexual nature ka koi bhi unwanted behaviour. Verbal: body par comments, sexual jokes, logon ko 'rate' karna, no ke baad bhi baar-baar poochna. Non-verbal: body parts ko ghoorna, seeti bajana, obscene ishaare, sexual images dikhana. Physical: jaan-boojhkar satna, groping, chikoti kaatna, zabardasti hug. Online: sexual messages, unwanted pictures, photos ki demand. Yeh bus mein, school mein, tuition mein, family mein aur DMs mein hota hai. Test yeh nahi hai ki saamne wala apni intention kya batata hai. Test yeh hai ki woh behaviour unwanted tha ya nahi. Ise 'eve-teasing' ya 'mazaak' bolna asliyat ko chhupana hai.

h.en: Grooming and abuse by people you trust
h.hg: Grooming aur trusted logon dwara abuse

body.en: Most sexual abuse of children is done by someone the child already knows, not by a stranger in a dark lane. That person may be a relative, family friend, teacher, coach, religious leader, senior or partner. Grooming usually moves in steps: choosing a child, winning trust (often the family's trust too), giving favours, creating secrecy, isolating, then pushing physical or sexual boundaries a little at a time, and finally using guilt, shame or threats to keep silence. Because it is gradual and the person is liked, many young people feel confused or loyal. Confusion is a normal response to manipulation, not agreement.
body.hg: Bachchon ka zyada-tar sexual abuse koi aisa insaan karta hai jise bachcha pehle se jaanta hai, andheri gali ka koi stranger nahi. Woh rishtedaar, family friend, teacher, coach, religious leader, senior ya partner ho sakta hai. Grooming usually step-by-step chalti hai: bachche ko choose karna, trust jeetna (aksar family ka bhi), favours dena, secrecy banana, baakiyon se isolate karna, phir physical ya sexual boundaries ko thoda-thoda push karna, aur end mein guilt, sharam ya dhamki se chup rakhna. Kyunki yeh dheere-dheere hota hai aur woh insaan sabko pasand hota hai, isliye bahut se teens confused ya loyal feel karte hain. Confusion manipulation ka normal response hai, agreement nahi.

body.en: Stalking is repeatedly following, watching or contacting someone who has clearly shown they are not interested. It includes waiting outside your school or home, tracking your location, flooding you with calls and messages, making new accounts after being blocked, and pressuring your friends for information. Films often show this as romance. In real life it is frightening, and it is a crime in India, including when it happens online. If it happens to you, do not meet the person alone to 'settle it'. Keep the messages and call logs, tell a trusted adult and report it.
body.hg: Stalking ka matlab hai kisi aise insaan ko baar-baar follow karna, us par nazar rakhna ya use contact karna jisne clearly dikha diya hai ki use interest nahi hai. Isme school ya ghar ke bahar wait karna, location track karna, calls aur messages ki jhadi lagana, block hone ke baad naye accounts banana aur tumhare friends par info ke liye pressure daalna shaamil hai. Filmein aksar ise romance ki tarah dikhati hain. Real life mein yeh darawna hai, aur India mein yeh crime hai, online ho tab bhi. Agar tumhare saath aisa ho, toh 'baat settle karne' ke liye us insaan se akele mat milo. Messages aur call logs sambhalkar rakho, kisi trusted adult ko batao aur report karo.

body.en: Under the POCSO Act, anyone under 18 is a child, and any sexual act with a child is an offence even if the child 'agreed'. The law protects children of all genders. Sexual harassment and stalking are also offences under India's criminal law. You can tell a parent, teacher or school counsellor, call 1098 or 112, or go to the police with an adult. Know one thing in advance: adults who learn that a child has been sexually abused are legally required to report it, so they cannot promise to keep it fully secret. Laws can change, and this is information, not legal advice.
body.hg: POCSO Act ke under 18 saal se kam umar ka har insaan child hai, aur child ke saath koi bhi sexual act offence hai, chahe child ne 'haan' bola ho. Yeh law har gender ke bachchon ko protect karta hai. Sexual harassment aur stalking bhi India ke criminal law mein offence hain. Tum parents, teacher ya school counsellor ko bata sakte ho, 1098 ya 112 par call kar sakte ho, ya kisi adult ke saath police ke paas ja sakte ho. Ek baat pehle se jaan lo: jin adults ko pata chalta hai ki kisi bachche ka sexual abuse hua hai, un par legally report karne ki duty hai, isliye woh ise poori tarah secret rakhne ka promise nahi kar sakte. Laws change ho sakte hain, aur yeh information hai, legal advice nahi.

claim.en: If I did not say no clearly, or I froze, it means I allowed it.
claim.hg: Agar maine clearly no nahi bola, ya meri body freeze ho gayi, toh matlab maine hone diya.

fact.en: Freezing or going silent is a common automatic reaction to fear and shock. Not resisting is not consent, and for anyone under 18 the law does not accept a child's 'yes' to a sexual act as consent at all.
fact.hg: Freeze ho jaana ya chup ho jaana darr aur shock ka common, automatic reaction hai. Resist na karna consent nahi hai, aur 18 se kam umar walon ke case mein law bachche ki 'haan' ko sexual act ka consent maanta hi nahi.

takeaways.en: Sexual harassment is defined by being unwanted, not by the harasser's excuse.
takeaways.hg: Sexual harassment is baat se define hota hai ki behaviour unwanted tha, harasser ke bahane se nahi.

takeaways.en: People who abuse are usually known and trusted, and they rely on favours, secrecy and guilt.
takeaways.hg: Abuse karne wale usually jaane-pehchaane aur trusted log hote hain, jo favours, secrecy aur guilt ka use karte hain.

takeaways.en: Stalking and harassment are offences, and POCSO protects everyone under 18 whatever their gender.
takeaways.hg: Stalking aur harassment offences hain, aur POCSO 18 se kam umar ke har insaan ko protect karta hai, gender koi bhi ho.

activity.en: Think of one film or series scene where chasing someone after they said no was shown as romantic. Privately, replay it from the other person's side: what would they be feeling on the walk home?
activity.hg: Kisi film ya series ka aisa scene yaad karo jisme 'no' ke baad bhi peeche pade rehna romantic dikhaya gaya tha. Mann hi mann use doosre insaan ki side se replay karo: ghar lautte hue use kaisa feel ho raha hoga?

q.en: A classmate keeps sending Ananya sexual jokes on chat even after she told him to stop. What is this, and what is a sound next step?
q.hg: Ek classmate Ananya ko chat par sexual jokes bhejta rehta hai, jabki woh use stop bol chuki hai. Yeh kya hai, aur agla sahi step kya hoga?

options.en: It is flirting; she should reply politely so he is not offended
options.hg: Yeh flirting hai; use politely reply karna chahiye taaki woh bura na maane

options.en: It is harmless because it is only online
options.hg: Yeh harmless hai kyunki sirf online hai

options.en: It is sexual harassment; she can keep the chat, block him and tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Yeh sexual harassment hai; woh chat save rakhe, use block kare aur trusted adult ko bataye

options.en: It is her fault for replying to him earlier
options.hg: Yeh uski galti hai kyunki usne pehle reply kiya tha

explain.en: Unwanted sexual messages that continue after a clear 'stop' are sexual harassment, online or offline. The responsibility lies with the sender.
explain.hg: Clear 'stop' ke baad bhi continue hone wale unwanted sexual messages sexual harassment hain, online ho ya offline. Responsibility bhejne wale ki hai.

q.en: Under POCSO, a sexual act with a person under 18 is an offence even if the child agreed.
q.hg: POCSO ke under 18 se kam umar ke insaan ke saath sexual act offence hai, chahe bachche ne haan bola ho.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: The law treats everyone under 18 as a child who cannot legally consent to sexual activity, so the child's agreement is not a defence.
explain.hg: Law 18 se kam umar ke har insaan ko child maanta hai jo sexual activity ke liye legally consent nahi de sakta, isliye bachche ki haan koi defence nahi hai.

warning.en: If you are being harassed, stalked or abused, you are not to blame. Call Child Helpline 1098, or 112 in an emergency.
warning.hg: Agar tumhare saath harassment, stalking ya abuse ho raha hai, toh blame tumhara nahi hai. Child Helpline 1098 par call karo, ya emergency mein 112 par.

title.en: Violence in Relationships and at Home
title.hg: Relationships aur Ghar ke Andar Violence

subtitle.en: Control, assault and trafficking, explained plainly
subtitle.hg: Control, assault aur trafficking, seedhi baat mein

hook.en: Abuse rarely starts with a slap. It starts with 'Who were you talking to?'
hook.hg: Abuse shayad hi kabhi thappad se start hota hai. Woh start hota hai 'Kisse baat kar rahe the?' se.

objectives.en: Recognise the forms of intimate partner and domestic violence, including the non-physical ones.
objectives.hg: Intimate partner violence aur domestic violence ke forms pehchanna, non-physical wale bhi.

objectives.en: Know what care exists after a sexual assault and which time limits matter.
objectives.hg: Jaanna ki sexual assault ke baad kaun si care milti hai aur kaun si time limits matter karti hain.

objectives.en: Recognise common trafficking tactics.
objectives.hg: Trafficking ke common tactics pehchanna.

h.en: Intimate partner violence is about control
h.hg: Intimate partner violence ka asli matlab control hai

body.en: Intimate partner violence is a pattern of behaviour by a current or former partner that causes harm or takes away your freedom. Physical: hitting, choking, throwing things. Emotional: insults, humiliation, threats to leave or to hurt themselves, constant blame. Sexual: pressure or force for any sexual act. Financial: taking your money, or stopping you from studying or working. Digital: demanding passwords, tracking your location, threatening to leak photos. It often cycles through tension, an incident, then apologies and affection, which is one reason leaving is hard. It happens in dating and in marriage, and to people of every gender.
body.hg: Intimate partner violence current ya ex partner ke behaviour ka aisa pattern hai jo harm karta hai ya aapki freedom chheenta hai. Physical: maarna, gala dabana, cheezein phenkna. Emotional: insult, humiliation, chhod dene ya khud ko hurt karne ki dhamki, har baat ka blame aap par. Sexual: kisi bhi sexual act ke liye pressure ya zabardasti. Financial: aapka paisa le lena, ya padhne aur kaam karne se rokna. Digital: passwords maangna, location track karna, photos leak karne ki dhamki. Aksar iski ek cycle chalti hai: tension, phir incident, phir sorry aur pyaar, aur yahi ek reason hai ki nikalna mushkil hota hai. Yeh dating mein bhi hota hai aur shaadi mein bhi, aur har gender ke logon ke saath.

body.en: Domestic violence is abuse inside a home or family: by a husband, in-laws, parents, siblings or a live-in partner. Children who watch it are harmed too, even if nobody touches them. The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 covers physical, sexual, verbal, emotional and economic abuse of women in a domestic relationship, and courts can order protection, the right to stay in the shared home and maintenance. Men, boys and LGBTQ+ people also face family violence; they can use the general criminal law, helplines and counselling. Women can call 181, anyone can call 112, and children can call 1098.
body.hg: Domestic violence ghar ya family ke andar hone wala abuse hai: husband, sasural wale, parents, siblings ya live-in partner ki taraf se. Jo bachche ise dekhte hain unhe bhi harm hota hai, chahe unhe koi haath na lagaye. Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 domestic relationship mein reh rahi women ke saath physical, sexual, verbal, emotional aur economic abuse ko cover karta hai, aur court protection, shared ghar mein rehne ka right aur maintenance ka order de sakti hai. Men, boys aur LGBTQ+ log bhi family violence face karte hain; woh general criminal law, helplines aur counselling ka sahara le sakte hain. Women 181 par, koi bhi 112 par aur bachche 1098 par call kar sakte hain.

h.hg: Sexual assault: kaun si help available hai

body.en: Sexual assault is any sexual act done without consent. It is most often committed by someone the person knows, and nothing a person wore, drank or said makes it their fault. Afterwards, safety comes first, then medical care, which matters even when there is no visible injury. Medicine to prevent HIV (PEP) has to start within 72 hours, and emergency contraception works up to 5 days, the sooner the better. Hospitals are required to treat survivors of sexual assault free of charge. If possible, not bathing or changing clothes before the examination helps preserve evidence, but care is given either way, and support is still available weeks or years later.
body.hg: Sexual assault woh koi bhi sexual act hai jo bina consent ke kiya jaye. Zyada-tar cases mein karne wala koi jaan-pehchaan ka hota hai, aur kisi ne kya pehna, kya piya ya kya bola, isse fault uska nahi ho jaata. Iske baad sabse pehle safety, phir medical care, jo tab bhi zaroori hai jab koi injury dikhe na. HIV se bachav ki medicine (PEP) 72 ghante ke andar start karni hoti hai, aur emergency contraception 5 din tak kaam karta hai, jitna jaldi utna better. Hospitals ke liye zaroori hai ki woh sexual assault survivors ka treatment free karein. Ho sake toh examination se pehle na nahana aur kapde na badalna evidence bachane mein help karta hai, lekin care har haal mein milti hai, aur hafton ya saalon baad bhi support mil sakta hai.

h.en: Trafficking: when an offer is a trap
h.hg: Trafficking: jab offer hi trap ho

body.en: Human trafficking means recruiting, moving or holding a person through deception, force or debt to exploit them, for example in forced labour, forced marriage, begging or commercial sexual exploitation. It rarely looks like a kidnapping. Usually it is an offer: a job in another city, a modelling or acting break, a marriage proposal, a 'sponsor' abroad. Warning signs are pressure to decide fast, vague details, someone else holding your ID or phone, travel costs that become debt, and being told not to tell your family. Verify offers independently, keep your own documents, share your live location with someone you trust, and call 112 or 1098 if something feels wrong.
body.hg: Human trafficking ka matlab hai kisi insaan ko dhoke, zabardasti ya karz ke through recruit karna, ek jagah se doosri jagah le jaana ya rokkar rakhna, taaki uska exploitation kiya ja sake, jaise forced labour, forced marriage, bheekh mangwana ya commercial sexual exploitation. Yeh shayad hi kabhi kidnapping jaisa dikhta hai. Zyada-tar yeh ek offer hota hai: doosre sheher mein job, modelling ya acting ka break, shaadi ka rishta, abroad mein koi 'sponsor'. Warning signs hain: jaldi decide karne ka pressure, vague details, aapka ID ya phone kisi aur ke paas hona, travel ka kharcha jo karz ban jaye, aur family ko na batane ki hidayat. Har offer ko khud independently verify karo, apne documents apne paas rakho, kisi trusted insaan ke saath live location share karo, aur kuch galat lage toh 112 ya 1098 par call karo.

claim.en: If it were really that bad, they would just leave.
claim.hg: Agar sach mein itna bura hota, toh woh chhodkar chale jaate.

fact.en: Leaving an abusive partner or home is hard and can be dangerous. People stay because of fear, money, children, family pressure, love and the hope that the person will change. Staying is not consent to abuse, and support should never depend on leaving.
fact.hg: Abusive partner ya ghar ko chhodna mushkil hai aur dangerous bhi ho sakta hai. Log darr, paise, bachchon, family pressure, pyaar aur is hope ki wajah se rukte hain ki saamne wala badal jayega. Ruke rehna abuse ke liye consent nahi hai, aur support kabhi is condition par nahi hona chahiye ki insaan chhodkar jaye.

takeaways.en: Abuse is a pattern of control, and it can be emotional, sexual, financial or digital without a single bruise.
takeaways.hg: Abuse control ka ek pattern hai, aur yeh bina ek bhi chot ke emotional, sexual, financial ya digital ho sakta hai.

takeaways.en: After sexual assault, medical care is time-sensitive: PEP within 72 hours and emergency contraception within 5 days.
takeaways.hg: Sexual assault ke baad medical care time-sensitive hai: PEP 72 ghante ke andar aur emergency contraception 5 din ke andar.

takeaways.en: Trafficking usually begins with a tempting offer rather than a kidnapping, so verify offers and keep your own documents.
takeaways.hg: Trafficking usually kidnapping se nahi, tempting offer se start hoti hai, isliye offers verify karo aur apne documents apne paas rakho.

activity.en: Somewhere private, note three people you could contact and one place you could go if you ever felt unsafe at home or with a partner. Save 112, 181 and 1098 in your phone.
activity.hg: Kisi private jagah par aise teen logon ke naam note karo jinse aap contact kar sako, aur ek jagah jahan aap ja sako, agar kabhi ghar par ya partner ke saath unsafe feel ho. Apne phone mein 112, 181 aur 1098 save karo.

q.en: Which of these is an example of financial abuse?
q.hg: Inme se kaun sa financial abuse ka example hai?

options.en: A partner suggesting that you both save for a trip
options.hg: Partner ka suggestion ki dono milkar trip ke liye saving karein

options.en: A partner disagreeing with how you spent your own money
options.hg: Partner ka is baat se disagree karna ki aapne apna paisa kaise kharch kiya

options.en: Parents asking a working adult child to share the rent
options.hg: Parents ka kamane wale adult bachche se rent mein hissa maangna

options.en: A partner taking your earnings and deciding whether you may study or work
options.hg: Partner ka aapki kamai le lena aur yeh decide karna ki aap padhoge ya kaam karoge ya nahi

explain.en: Financial abuse is using money to control someone: taking their income or blocking their education and work so that they cannot be independent.
explain.hg: Financial abuse ka matlab hai paise ke through kisi ko control karna: uski income le lena ya padhai aur kaam rok dena taaki woh independent na ho sake.

q.en: Medicine to prevent HIV after an assault (PEP) can be started at any time within a month.
q.hg: Assault ke baad HIV se bachav ki medicine (PEP) ek mahine ke andar kabhi bhi start ki ja sakti hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: PEP needs urgent medical assessment and must be started as early as possible, no later than 72 hours after the exposure. It is then taken for 28 days.
explain.hg: PEP ke liye urgent medical assessment chahiye aur ise jaldi se jaldi, exposure ke 72 ghante ke andar start karna hota hai. Phir ise 28 din tak liya jaata hai.

warning.en: In immediate danger, call 112. After a sexual assault, reach a hospital as early as you can: HIV-prevention medicine must start within 72 hours and emergency contraception works up to 5 days.
warning.hg: Immediate danger ho toh 112 par call karo. Sexual assault ke baad jitni jaldi ho sake hospital pahuncho: HIV-prevention medicine 72 ghante ke andar start karni hoti hai aur emergency contraception 5 din tak kaam karta hai.

title.en: Helping a Friend, Reporting and Your Rights
title.hg: Dost ki Help, Reporting aur Tumhare Rights

subtitle.en: What to say, who to call, what you are owed
subtitle.hg: Kya bolna hai, kisko call karna hai, tumhara haq kya hai

hook.en: You do not have to be a hero or a lawyer. You have to believe your friend and know the next step.
hook.hg: Tumhe na hero banna hai, na lawyer. Bas apne dost par yakeen karna hai aur next step pata hona chahiye.

objectives.en: Use safe bystander options when you see harassment.
objectives.hg: Harassment hote dekho toh safe bystander options use karna.

objectives.en: Respond to a friend's disclosure without blame or pressure.
objectives.hg: Dost ke batane par bina blame aur bina pressure ke respond karna.

objectives.en: Explain how reporting works, the limits of confidentiality and the rights of survivors.
objectives.hg: Samjhana ki reporting kaise hoti hai, confidentiality ki limits kya hain aur survivors ke rights kya hain.

body.en: When you see harassment or bullying, you have more options than fighting or filming. Distract: interrupt casually, ask the person being targeted for the time or pretend you know them. Delegate: bring in a teacher, bus conductor, guard or other adults. Delay: check on the person afterwards and ask what they need. Document: note the time, place and what happened, and give it to the person harmed; never post it. Direct: say 'Stop, that's not okay', only if it is safe. Your own safety comes first. Even a small interruption tells the person they are not alone.
body.hg: Jab tum harassment ya bullying hote dekho, toh ladne ya video banane ke alawa bhi options hain. Distract: casually beech mein aa jao, jise target kiya ja raha hai usse time poocho ya aise baat karo jaise use jaante ho. Delegate: teacher, bus conductor, guard ya doosre adults ko involve karo. Delay: baad mein us insaan ka haal poocho aur poocho ki use kya chahiye. Document: time, jagah aur jo hua woh note karo aur usi insaan ko do jise harm hua; kabhi post mat karo. Direct: bolo 'Stop, yeh theek nahi hai', par tabhi jab aisa karna safe ho. Tumhari apni safety sabse pehle hai. Chhota sa interruption bhi us insaan ko bata deta hai ki woh akela nahi hai.

body.en: If a friend tells you they were harassed or abused, how you react in the first minute matters. Listen without interrupting. Say: 'I believe you', 'It's not your fault', 'Thank you for telling me'. Do not ask why they didn't run, what they were wearing or why they waited. Do not demand details, confront the person or spread it in the group. People react to trauma differently: crying, laughing, going numb, forgetting parts, staying friendly with the person. All of that is normal. Ask what they want next and help them reach a safe adult. Look after yourself too; you can also talk to an adult.
body.hg: Agar koi dost tumhe bataye ki uske saath harassment ya abuse hua hai, toh pehle ek minute mein tumhara reaction bahut matter karta hai. Bina toke suno. Bolo: 'Mujhe tum par yakeen hai', 'Yeh tumhari galti nahi hai', 'Mujhe batane ke liye thank you'. Yeh mat poocho ki woh bhaaga kyun nahi, usne kya pehna tha ya itne din kyun ruka. Details mat maango, us insaan ko confront karne mat jao aur baat group mein mat failao. Trauma par har koi alag tarah se react karta hai: rona, hansna, numb ho jaana, kuch parts bhool jaana, us insaan ke saath normal behave karte rehna. Yeh sab normal hai. Poocho ki woh aage kya chahta hai, aur use kisi safe adult tak pahunchne mein help karo. Apna bhi dhyaan rakho; tum bhi kisi adult se baat kar sakte ho.

h.en: Reporting and the limits of secrecy

body.en: Help can start with one call: 1098 for children, 112 for emergencies, 181 for women, 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in for online abuse. A complaint can be made at any police station, wherever the incident happened. Be honest with your friend about one thing: when a person under 18 is sexually abused, the law requires adults who know about it, including doctors, teachers and counsellors, to inform the police. So they can keep it private from classmates and neighbours, but they cannot promise total secrecy. A good counsellor explains this before you share and tells you what happens next. An adult survivor decides for themselves whether to file a police complaint.
body.hg: Help ek call se start ho sakti hai: bachchon ke liye 1098, emergency ke liye 112, women ke liye 181, online abuse ke liye 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in. Complaint kisi bhi police station mein ki ja sakti hai, incident chahe kahin bhi hua ho. Apne dost se ek baat honestly bolo: jab 18 se kam umar ke kisi insaan ka sexual abuse hota hai, toh law ke hisaab se jin adults ko pata ho, doctors, teachers aur counsellors bhi, unhe police ko inform karna hota hai. Isliye woh baat ko classmates aur padosiyon se private rakh sakte hain, lekin total secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakte. Achha counsellor yeh baat tumhare kuch share karne se pehle hi samjha deta hai aur batata hai ki aage kya hoga. Adult survivor khud decide karta hai ki police complaint file karni hai ya nahi.

h.hg: Survivors ke rights aur professional care

body.en: A survivor has rights. Their name and identity must not be published by the media or shared publicly. A child's statement is meant to be recorded in a child-friendly way, with a parent or another trusted person present. Hospitals must give medical care, and women and children are entitled to free legal aid. Healing often needs professionals: a doctor for the body, and a counsellor or psychologist for sleep problems, fear, flashbacks or guilt. Tele-MANAS on 14416 offers free mental-health support, and One Stop Centres, reached through 181, bring medical, legal and counselling help together for women. Seeking help late is still seeking help.
body.hg: Survivor ke rights hote hain. Unka naam aur identity media mein publish ya publicly share nahi ki ja sakti. Bachche ka statement child-friendly tareeke se record hona chahiye, parent ya kisi aur trusted insaan ki maujoodgi mein. Hospitals ko medical care deni hi hoti hai, aur women aur bachchon ko free legal aid ka haq hai. Heal hone ke liye aksar professionals chahiye hote hain: body ke liye doctor, aur neend ki problem, darr, flashbacks ya guilt ke liye counsellor ya psychologist. Tele-MANAS 14416 par free mental-health support deta hai, aur 181 ke through milne wale One Stop Centres women ko medical, legal aur counselling help ek hi jagah dete hain. Der se help maangna bhi help maangna hi hai.

claim.en: A real friend promises to keep it secret no matter what.
claim.hg: Sachcha dost har haal mein secret rakhne ka promise karta hai.

fact.en: A real friend keeps it away from gossip but does not carry a dangerous secret alone. If someone is being abused or is at risk, involving a safe adult or calling 1098 is how you protect them.
fact.hg: Sachcha dost baat ko gossip se door rakhta hai, par dangerous secret akele carry nahi karta. Agar kisi ka abuse ho raha hai ya woh risk mein hai, toh kisi safe adult ko involve karna ya 1098 par call karna hi use protect karne ka tareeka hai.

takeaways.en: You can distract, delegate, delay, document or speak up directly, as long as you keep yourself safe.
takeaways.hg: Tum distract, delegate, delay, document ya directly bol sakte ho, bas khud safe raho.

takeaways.en: The most helpful words to a friend are 'I believe you' and 'It's not your fault'.
takeaways.hg: Dost ke liye sabse helpful words hain 'Mujhe tum par yakeen hai' aur 'Yeh tumhari galti nahi hai'.

takeaways.en: Help is reachable through 1098, 112, 181 or any police station, and nobody can honestly promise a minor total secrecy about sexual abuse.
takeaways.hg: Help 1098, 112, 181 ya kisi bhi police station se mil sakti hai, aur koi bhi honestly minor ko sexual abuse ke baare mein total secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakta.

activity.en: Make a small safety card in your wallet or notes app: 112, 1098, 181, 14416, the numbers of two trusted adults and one safe place near your school or home. That is the start of an emergency plan.
activity.hg: Apne wallet ya notes app mein ek chhota safety card banao: 112, 1098, 181, 14416, do trusted adults ke numbers aur school ya ghar ke paas ki ek safe jagah. Yahi emergency plan ki shuruaat hai.

q.en: Your friend Kabir tells you that an older cousin has been touching him in ways he hates. What is the best first thing to say?
q.hg: Tumhara dost Kabir batata hai ki ek bada cousin use aise touch karta hai jo use bilkul pasand nahi. Sabse pehle kya bolna best hoga?

options.en: I believe you. It's not your fault. I'm glad you told me.
options.hg: Mujhe tum par yakeen hai. Yeh tumhari galti nahi hai. Achha kiya jo mujhe bataya.

options.en: Are you sure? That doesn't happen to boys.
options.hg: Pakka? Ladkon ke saath aisa nahi hota.

options.en: Why didn't you just stop him?
options.hg: Tumne use roka kyun nahi?

options.en: Let's go and confront him together tonight.
options.hg: Chalo aaj raat hum dono milkar use confront karte hain.

explain.en: Being believed and not blamed is what helps most at first. After that, you can help him reach a safe adult or call 1098; confronting the person can put him at risk.
explain.hg: Shuru mein sabse zyada help isi se milti hai ki us par yakeen kiya jaye aur blame na kiya jaye. Uske baad tum use kisi safe adult tak pahunchne ya 1098 par call karne mein help kar sakte ho; us insaan ko confront karna Kabir ko risk mein daal sakta hai.

q.en: A counsellor cannot promise complete secrecy to a 15-year-old who reports sexual abuse.
q.hg: Counsellor sexual abuse report karne wale 15 saal ke teen ko complete secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakta.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: POCSO makes reporting mandatory when an adult learns of a sexual offence against a child, so honest professionals explain this limit before you share.
explain.hg: POCSO ke under jab kisi adult ko bachche ke khilaaf sexual offence ka pata chalta hai toh report karna mandatory hai, isliye honest professionals yeh limit pehle hi bata dete hain.

warning.en: If you or a friend are in danger right now, call 112. For children and teens, 1098 is free and open day and night. Laws can change; this is information, not legal advice.
warning.hg: Agar tum ya tumhara dost abhi danger mein hai, toh 112 par call karo. Bachchon aur teens ke liye 1098 free hai aur din-raat khula hai. Laws change ho sakte hain; yeh information hai, legal advice nahi.

title.en: Violence in the Name of Family

subtitle.en: Dowry, 'honour', forced marriage and acid attacks, without the excuses
subtitle.hg: Dahej, 'izzat', forced marriage aur acid attacks, bina kisi bahane ke

hook.en: Some of the worst violence in India is planned at home, by relatives, and then described as tradition, honour or 'a family matter'.
hook.hg: India mein sabse buri violence ka ek hissa ghar ke andar, rishtedaaron dwara plan hota hai, aur phir use tradition, izzat ya 'ghar ka maamla' bol diya jaata hai.

objectives.en: Recognise dowry abuse, 'honour' violence, forced marriage, child marriage and acid attacks as crimes, not customs.
objectives.hg: Dahej abuse, 'izzat' ke naam par violence, forced marriage, child marriage aur acid attacks ko custom nahi, crime ke roop mein pehchanna.

objectives.en: Understand why families hide this violence and why silence protects the person doing harm.
objectives.hg: Samajhna ki families is violence ko kyun chhupati hain aur chuppi harm karne wale ko hi kyun bachati hai.

objectives.en: Know who to contact: 112, 181, 1098, the police, Protection Officers and free legal aid on 15100.
objectives.hg: Jaanna ki kisse contact karna hai: 112, 181, 1098, police, Protection Officers aur 15100 par free legal aid.

h.en: Dowry: a demand that does not stop at the wedding
h.hg: Dahej: woh demand jo shaadi ke saath khatam nahi hoti

body.en: Dowry is money, gold, vehicles or property demanded from a bride's family for a marriage. Giving, taking and demanding it are all illegal in India, yet it remains common, renamed 'gifts' or 'custom'. The demand rarely ends with the wedding. It can continue for years as taunts, withheld money, beatings and threats to send the woman back, and in the worst cases it ends in her death. The husband and his relatives, women as well as men, can take part. Dowry also traps men: sons are priced like assets, and those who refuse are often overruled by their families. Cruelty to a wife and dowry deaths are serious crimes.
body.hg: Dahej woh paisa, sona, gaadi ya property hai jo shaadi ke liye dulhan ki family se maangi jaati hai. India mein dahej dena, lena aur maangna teeno illegal hain, phir bhi yeh common hai, bas naam badalkar 'gifts' ya 'rivaaz' ho jaata hai. Demand shaadi ke saath shayad hi khatam hoti hai. Woh saalon tak taanon, paisa rokne, maarpeet aur maayke wapas bhej dene ki dhamkiyon ke roop mein chal sakti hai, aur worst cases mein woman ki maut par khatam hoti hai. Husband aur uske rishtedaar, women bhi aur men bhi, isme shaamil ho sakte hain. Dahej men ko bhi trap karta hai: beton ka price assets ki tarah lagaya jaata hai, aur jo mana karte hain unki baat aksar unki family hi nahi maanti. Wife ke saath cruelty aur dowry deaths serious crimes hain.

h.en: Punished for choosing: 'honour' violence and acid attacks
h.hg: Apni choice ki saza: 'izzat' ke naam par violence aur acid attacks

body.en: 'Honour' violence is harm done by relatives, sometimes backed by community groups, to punish someone for choosing a partner of another caste, religion or the same gender, or for refusing a match. It includes confinement, beatings and murder, and young men are killed as well as young women. The word 'honour' only hides a crime. The Supreme Court has said two adults need nobody's approval to choose each other, and that police must protect them. Acid attacks follow the same logic of punishment, often after a rejected proposal. Many survivors are women who said no, but men and children are attacked too. It is a specific, heavily punished offence.
body.hg: 'Honour' ya 'izzat' ke naam par violence woh harm hai jo rishtedaar, kabhi-kabhi community groups ke saath milkar, kisi ko is baat ki saza dene ke liye karte hain ki usne doosri caste, doosre religion ya same gender ka partner chuna, ya fix kiya hua rishta thukra diya. Isme band karke rakhna, maarpeet aur murder shaamil hain, aur isme young men bhi maare jaate hain, sirf young women nahi. 'Izzat' word sirf ek crime ko chhupata hai. Supreme Court keh chuka hai ki do adults ko ek-doosre ko choose karne ke liye kisi ki approval nahi chahiye, aur police ko unhe protect karna chahiye. Acid attacks ke peeche bhi saza dene ki yahi soch hoti hai, aksar kisi reject kiye gaye proposal ke baad. Bahut se survivors woh women hain jinhone 'na' kaha, lekin men aur bachchon par bhi attacks hote hain. Yeh ek specific, kadi saza wala offence hai.

body.en: In a forced marriage, at least one person has not freely agreed. The force can be emotional blackmail, threats, taking away a phone, stopping college, or a sudden 'visit to relatives'. It happens to women, men, and LGBTQ+ people married off to 'fix' them. Consent obtained by force or fraud is a ground for a court to cancel a marriage. Child marriage means the woman is under 18 or the man under 21, and arranging or performing one is illegal. It cuts short schooling, brings early and riskier pregnancy, and raises the risk of violence. Marriage does not change POCSO: sexual activity with anyone under 18 remains an offence.
body.hg: Forced marriage mein kam se kam ek insaan ne apni marzi se haan nahi kaha hota. Zabardasti emotional blackmail, dhamki, phone chheen lena, college chhudwa dena, ya achanak 'rishtedaaron ke yahan chalne' ki baat bhi ho sakti hai. Yeh women, men aur un LGBTQ+ logon ke saath hota hai jinki shaadi unhe 'theek karne' ke liye kar di jaati hai. Zabardasti ya dhoke se li gayi consent woh ground hai jis par court shaadi ko cancel kar sakti hai. Child marriage ka matlab hai ki ladki 18 se kam ya ladka 21 se kam umar ka ho, aur aisi shaadi fix karna ya karwana illegal hai. Isse padhai chhoot jaati hai, kam umar mein zyada risky pregnancy hoti hai, aur violence ka khatra badhta hai. Shaadi se POCSO nahi badalta: 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath sexual activity offence hi rehti hai.

h.en: Why families cover it up, and where to go
h.hg: Families ise kyun chhupati hain, aur help kahan milegi

body.en: Families hide this violence for reasons that feel powerful: fear of what people will say, money spent on a wedding, a sibling's marriage prospects, dependence on the abuser, and the belief that a daughter must 'adjust'. Silence protects the abuser, never the person being hurt. In danger call 112; women can call 181; anyone under 18 can call 1098, including to stop a child marriage. Any police station can take a complaint. Protection Officers under the domestic violence law, and One Stop Centres reached through 181, help women with shelter, medical care and court orders. NALSA gives free legal aid on 15100. Tell one trusted person outside the home.
body.hg: Families is violence ko un reasons se chhupati hain jo bahut powerful lagte hain: log kya kahenge ka darr, shaadi par kharch hua paisa, bhai-behen ke rishte ki chinta, abuser par dependence, aur yeh soch ki beti ko 'adjust' karna hi hoga. Chuppi abuser ko bachati hai, use kabhi nahi jise hurt kiya ja raha hai. Danger mein 112 par call karo; women 181 par call kar sakti hain; 18 se kam umar ka koi bhi insaan 1098 par call kar sakta hai, child marriage rukwane ke liye bhi. Complaint kisi bhi police station mein di ja sakti hai. Domestic violence law ke under Protection Officers, aur 181 ke through milne wale One Stop Centres, women ko shelter, medical care aur court orders dilane mein help karte hain. NALSA 15100 par free legal aid deta hai. Ghar ke bahar ke kisi ek trusted insaan ko zaroor batao.

claim.en: What happens inside a family is a private matter, and outsiders should stay out of it.
claim.hg: Family ke andar jo hota hai woh private maamla hai, bahar walon ko usme nahi padna chahiye.

fact.en: Violence does not become private because relatives commit it. Dowry harassment, forced or child marriage, confinement and 'honour' attacks are crimes, and the law allows neighbours, friends, teachers and relatives to alert the police or a helpline. Stepping in can save a life.
fact.hg: Violence isliye private nahi ho jaati ki use rishtedaar kar rahe hain. Dahej ke liye harass karna, forced ya child marriage, band karke rakhna aur 'izzat' ke naam par attacks crimes hain, aur law padosiyon, doston, teachers aur rishtedaaron ko police ya helpline ko inform karne ki permission deta hai. Beech mein aane se kisi ki jaan bach sakti hai.

takeaways.en: Dowry, 'honour' violence, forced marriage, child marriage and acid attacks are crimes under Indian law, whatever a family calls them.
takeaways.hg: Dahej, 'izzat' ke naam par violence, forced marriage, child marriage aur acid attacks Indian law mein crimes hain, family unhe chahe jo naam de.

takeaways.en: They harm women most often, but men, boys and LGBTQ+ people are targeted too, and relatives of any gender can be the ones doing harm.
takeaways.hg: Inka sabse zyada harm women ko hota hai, lekin men, boys aur LGBTQ+ log bhi target hote hain, aur harm karne wale rishtedaar kisi bhi gender ke ho sakte hain.

takeaways.en: Help exists outside the family: 112, 181, 1098, the police, Protection Officers and free legal aid on 15100.
takeaways.hg: Help family ke bahar available hai: 112, 181, 1098, police, Protection Officers aur 15100 par free legal aid.

activity.en: Privately, write down the phone number of one adult outside your household whom you would trust in a family crisis, and save 112, 181, 1098 and 15100 in your phone. Then think of one sentence you could say to a friend who tells you they are being forced into a marriage.
activity.hg: Privately, ghar ke bahar ke kisi ek aise adult ka phone number likho jis par tum family crisis mein trust kar sako, aur 112, 181, 1098 aur 15100 apne phone mein save karo. Phir ek aisa sentence socho jo tum us friend se keh sako jo bataye ki uski shaadi zabardasti karwayi ja rahi hai.

q.en: Pooja is 17. Her parents have fixed her wedding for next month and say she has no say in it. Which step fits both her safety and the law?
q.hg: Pooja 17 saal ki hai. Uske parents ne agle mahine uski shaadi fix kar di hai aur kehte hain ki isme uski koi say nahi hai. Kaun sa step uski safety aur law dono ke hisaab se sahi hai?

options.en: Agree for now and plan to ask for a divorce after a few years
options.hg: Abhi maan jaye aur kuch saal baad divorce maangne ka plan kare

options.en: Call 1098 or tell a trusted teacher, because a marriage under 18 is illegal and can be stopped
options.hg: 1098 par call kare ya kisi trusted teacher ko bataye, kyunki 18 se kam umar mein shaadi illegal hai aur rukwayi ja sakti hai

options.en: Leave home alone for another city without telling anyone
options.hg: Kisi ko bataye bina akele doosre sheher chali jaye

options.en: Wait until she turns 18, since nothing can be done before that
options.hg: 18 ki hone tak wait kare, kyunki usse pehle kuch nahi ho sakta

explain.en: A marriage where the woman is under 18 is a child marriage. Childline 1098, the police or a Child Marriage Prohibition Officer can act to stop it, and a court can order that it must not take place.
explain.hg: Jis shaadi mein ladki 18 se kam umar ki ho, woh child marriage hai. Childline 1098, police ya Child Marriage Prohibition Officer ise rukwane ke liye action le sakte hain, aur court order de sakti hai ki yeh shaadi na ho.

q.en: Someone has had acid thrown on them. While help is on the way, what is the right first aid?
q.hg: Kisi par acid phenka gaya hai. Help aane tak sahi first aid kya hai?

options.en: Apply ice and a thick layer of ointment
options.hg: Ice aur ointment ki moti layer lagana

options.en: Cover the area tightly with cloth and wait
options.hg: Us area ko kapde se kaskar dhakkar wait karna

options.en: Rub in milk or oil to neutralise the acid
options.hg: Acid ka asar khatam karne ke liye doodh ya tel malna

options.en: Rinse with plenty of clean running water for at least 20 minutes
options.hg: Kam se kam 20 minute tak khoob saare saaf behte paani se dhona

explain.en: Flushing with lots of clean running water dilutes and removes the chemical and limits how deep the burn goes. Creams, oil and ice can make it worse. Call 112 and get to a hospital.
explain.hg: Khoob saare saaf behte paani se dhone par chemical dilute hokar hat jaata hai aur burn kam gehra hota hai. Cream, tel aur ice haalat bigaad sakte hain. 112 par call karo aur hospital pahuncho.

warning.en: If someone is in danger now, call 112. For an acid burn, rinse the area with plenty of clean running water for at least 20 minutes, remove contaminated clothing carefully and get to a hospital; do not apply creams, oil or ice. Legal points here are general information as of 14 November 2026, not legal advice, and not yet reviewed by a lawyer; laws can change.
warning.hg: Agar koi abhi danger mein hai, toh 112 par call karo. Acid burn hone par us area ko kam se kam 20 minute tak khoob saare saaf behte paani se dho, acid lage kapde carefully hatao aur hospital pahuncho; cream, tel ya ice mat lagao. Yahan di gayi legal baatein 14 November 2026 tak ki general information hain, legal advice nahi, aur abhi kisi lawyer ne inhe review nahi kiya hai; laws badal sakte hain.

title.en: Boys and Men Are Survivors Too
title.hg: Ladke aur Men bhi Survivors Hote Hain

subtitle.en: The abuse nobody asks about, and the silence around it
subtitle.hg: Woh abuse jiske baare mein koi poochta nahi, aur uske around ki chuppi

hook.en: Boys are told to be careful about many things. Almost nobody tells them that sexual abuse can happen to them too, so when it does, most say nothing for years.
hook.hg: Ladkon ko bahut si cheezon mein careful rehna sikhaya jaata hai. Par almost koi unhe yeh nahi batata ki sexual abuse unke saath bhi ho sakta hai, isliye jab hota hai toh zyada-tar saalon tak kuch nahi bolte.

objectives.en: Understand that sexual abuse and assault happen to boys and men, and who commits them.
objectives.hg: Samajhna ki sexual abuse aur assault ladkon aur men ke saath bhi hota hai, aur ise kaun karta hai.

objectives.en: Replace common myths about male bodies, strength and consent with facts.
objectives.hg: Male body, strength aur consent se jude common myths ki jagah facts rakhna.

objectives.en: Know what the law covers, where it falls short, and where a male survivor can get help.
objectives.hg: Jaanna ki law kya cover karta hai, kahan kamzor padta hai, aur male survivor ko help kahan mil sakti hai.

h.en: It happens, and it stays hidden
h.hg: Yeh hota hai, aur chhupa reh jaata hai

body.en: Sexual abuse of boys is common in India and worldwide, and is reported far less often than it happens. The person responsible is usually someone known: a relative, neighbour, older student, teacher, coach, religious teacher, hostel warden or employer. It also happens as ragging and 'initiation' in hostels and teams, where sexual humiliation is passed off as a joke. Adult men are sexually assaulted too, by partners, acquaintances, groups and strangers, and in places such as hostels and custody. Most of those who do this are men, but some are women. A survivor's gender does not change what was done to him or how seriously it should be taken.
body.hg: Ladkon ka sexual abuse India aur poori duniya mein common hai, aur jitna hota hai usse bahut kam report hota hai. Responsible insaan usually koi jaan-pehchaan ka hota hai: rishtedaar, padosi, senior student, teacher, coach, religious teacher, hostel warden ya employer. Yeh hostels aur teams mein ragging aur 'initiation' ke naam par bhi hota hai, jahan sexual humiliation ko mazaak bolkar taal diya jaata hai. Adult men par bhi sexual assault hota hai, partners, jaan-pehchaan walon, groups aur strangers dwara, aur hostel aur custody jaisi jagahon mein. Aisa karne wale zyada-tar men hote hain, lekin kuch women bhi hoti hain. Survivor ka gender is baat ko nahi badalta ki uske saath kya kiya gaya aur use kitni seriously liya jaana chahiye.

body.en: An erection or ejaculation is a reflex. It can happen with fear, stress or touch, and it says nothing about consent or enjoyment; abusers often use it to confuse a boy into silence. Size and strength do not prevent assault, because it usually works through trust, authority, threats, shock, intoxication or being outnumbered. Freezing instead of fighting is a normal survival response. Being assaulted by a man does not change or reveal anyone's sexual orientation. Sexual contact between a woman and a boy under 18 is abuse, not luck. Most boys who are abused never go on to abuse anyone; that fear keeps many survivors silent for no reason.
body.hg: Erection ya ejaculation ek reflex hai. Yeh darr, stress ya physical contact se ho sakta hai, aur consent ya enjoyment ke baare mein kuch nahi batata; abusers aksar isi ko use karke ladke ko confuse karte hain taaki woh chup rahe. Size aur strength assault ko nahi rokte, kyunki woh usually trust, authority, dhamki, shock, nashe ya numbers mein zyada hone ke through hota hai. Fight karne ki jagah freeze ho jaana ek normal survival response hai. Kisi man dwara assault hone se kisi ki sexual orientation na badalti hai, na reveal hoti hai. Kisi woman aur 18 se kam umar ke ladke ke beech sexual contact abuse hai, luck nahi. Aur jin ladkon ka abuse hota hai unme se zyada-tar kabhi kisi ko abuse nahi karte; yeh darr bahut se survivors ko bina wajah chup rakhta hai.

h.en: Why men stay silent, and what silence costs
h.hg: Men chup kyun rehte hain, aur chuppi ki keemat

body.en: Boys learn early that men do not cry, do not complain and are never victims. So a male survivor may fear being laughed at, called weak, having his sexuality questioned, or not being believed. Many have no words for what happened and tell no one for decades. The harm is real anyway: shame, anger, anxiety, depression, poor sleep, flashbacks, heavy drinking or drugs, trouble with trust and intimacy, and sometimes thoughts of self-harm. These are injuries, not weakness. They respond to support, and recovery is possible at any age. Speaking to one safe person, a counsellor, or Tele-MANAS on 14416 is a strong first step, however long ago it happened.
body.hg: Ladke bachpan se seekh lete hain ki mard rote nahi, complain nahi karte aur kabhi victim nahi hote. Isliye male survivor ko darr ho sakta hai ki us par hansa jayega, use weak bola jayega, uski sexuality par sawaal uthenge, ya bas uski baat maani hi nahi jayegi. Bahuton ke paas jo hua uske liye words hi nahi hote, aur bahut se log decades tak kisi ko nahi batate. Harm phir bhi real hota hai: sharam, gussa, anxiety, depression, kharab neend, flashbacks, zyada sharaab ya drugs, trust aur intimacy mein mushkil, aur kabhi-kabhi self-harm ke thoughts. Yeh injuries hain, weakness nahi. Support milne par yeh theek hone lagti hain, aur kisi bhi umar mein recovery possible hai. Kisi ek safe insaan, counsellor ya Tele-MANAS (14416) se baat karna ek strong first step hai, baat chahe kitni bhi purani ho.

h.en: The law, honestly, and where to get help
h.hg: Law ki honest picture, aur help kahan milegi

body.en: POCSO protects every child under 18, whatever the child's or abuser's gender, and adults who learn of abuse must report it. For adults the law is weaker: the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita defines rape as committed by a man against a woman, and an older provision used for assaults on men was dropped. Adult men may rely on offences such as hurt, confinement or intimidation; the transgender rights law punishes sexual abuse far more lightly than rape. Ask a lawyer. Adults can get counselling and legal aid without a police case: 112 in danger, 14416, 15100. Under 18, call 1098; helpers must report. Hospitals start HIV prevention within 72 hours.
body.hg: POCSO 18 se kam umar ke har child ko protect karta hai, child ya abuser ka gender chahe jo ho, aur jin adults ko abuse ka pata chale unhe report karna hota hai. Adults ke liye law kamzor hai: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita rape ko man dwara woman ke against kiya gaya offence maanti hai, aur jo purana provision men par assault ke cases mein use hota tha, woh hata diya gaya. Adult man ko hurt, confinement ya intimidation jaise offences ka sahara lena pad sakta hai; transgender rights law sexual abuse ko offence maanta hai, lekin saza rape se bahut kam hai. Is par lawyer ki advice lo. Adults bina police case ke counselling aur legal advice le sakte hain: danger mein 112, 14416, 15100. 18 se kam ho toh 1098 par call karo; help karne wale adults ko report karna hota hai. Hospitals 72 ghante ke andar HIV prevention medicine bhi start karte hain.

claim.en: A real man can always fight off an attacker, so a man cannot be sexually assaulted.
claim.hg: Asli mard hamesha attacker se ladkar bach sakta hai, isliye kisi man par sexual assault ho hi nahi sakta.

fact.en: Assault rarely depends on physical strength. It works through trust, authority, threats, intoxication, surprise or numbers, and freezing is a normal reaction to danger. Men and boys of every build are assaulted, and it is never a measure of their manhood.
fact.hg: Assault shayad hi kabhi physical strength par depend karta hai. Woh trust, authority, dhamki, nashe, surprise ya numbers ke through hota hai, aur danger mein freeze ho jaana ek normal reaction hai. Har build ke men aur boys par assault hota hai, aur yeh kabhi unki mardangi ka measure nahi hai.

takeaways.en: Sexual abuse and assault happen to boys and men, usually by someone they know, and are reported far less than they occur.
takeaways.hg: Sexual abuse aur assault ladkon aur men ke saath bhi hota hai, usually kisi jaan-pehchaan wale dwara, aur jitna hota hai usse bahut kam report hota hai.

takeaways.en: An erection, freezing or staying silent afterwards is never consent and never the survivor's fault.
takeaways.hg: Erection, freeze ho jaana ya baad mein chup rehna kabhi consent nahi hai aur kabhi survivor ki galti nahi hai.

takeaways.en: POCSO protects boys under 18 fully; the law for adult men is weaker, but medical care, counselling and legal aid are still available.
takeaways.hg: POCSO 18 se kam umar ke ladkon ko poori tarah protect karta hai; adult men ke liye law kamzor hai, phir bhi medical care, counselling aur legal aid available hai.

activity.en: Think about the last time you heard a joke about a boy or man being assaulted, or 'getting lucky' with an older woman. Privately, write one sentence you could say next time instead of laughing. Then save 14416 and 1098 in your phone.
activity.hg: Yaad karo ki last time tumne kisi ladke ya man par assault ka, ya older woman ke saath uske 'lucky' hone ka joke kab suna tha. Privately ek aisa sentence likho jo tum next time hansne ki jagah bol sako. Phir 14416 aur 1098 apne phone mein save karo.

q.en: Kabir, 19, tells his roommate that a senior sexually assaulted him last month. Which response helps most?
q.hg: Kabir, 19, apne roommate ko batata hai ki last month ek senior ne us par sexual assault kiya tha. Kaun sa response sabse zyada help karega?

options.en: Say 'I believe you, it was not your fault' and ask what he needs, including a doctor or counsellor
options.hg: Bolna 'Mujhe tum par yakeen hai, tumhari koi galti nahi thi' aur poochna ki use kya chahiye, doctor ya counsellor samet

options.en: Ask why he did not fight back, since he is stronger than the senior
options.hg: Poochna ki usne fight back kyun nahi kiya, jabki woh senior se zyada strong hai

options.en: Tell the rest of the hostel so that the senior is exposed
options.hg: Poore hostel ko bata dena taaki senior expose ho jaye

options.en: Advise him to forget it, because nothing can be done for men
options.hg: Use bhool jaane ki advice dena, kyunki men ke liye kuch nahi ho sakta

explain.en: Being believed is what most survivors need first. Asking why he did not fight adds blame, spreading his story takes away his control, and medical care, counselling and legal advice do exist for men.
explain.hg: Zyada-tar survivors ko sabse pehle yahi chahiye hota hai ki unki baat par yakeen kiya jaye. Fight na karne ka sawaal blame add karta hai, uski story failana usse uska control chheen leta hai, aur medical care, counselling aur legal advice men ke liye bhi available hain.

q.en: If a boy or man had an erection during unwanted sexual contact, it means he consented.
q.hg: Agar unwanted sexual contact ke dauraan kisi ladke ya man ko erection hua, toh iska matlab hai ki uski consent thi.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: An erection or ejaculation is a physical reflex that can happen under fear or stress. Consent is a free and clear agreement, and a reflex is not that.
explain.hg: Erection ya ejaculation ek physical reflex hai jo darr ya stress mein bhi ho sakta hai. Consent ka matlab hai free aur clear agreement, aur reflex woh nahi hai.

warning.en: If you are in danger, call 112; if you are under 18, call 1098. After a sexual assault, reach a hospital quickly, because HIV prevention medicine must start within 72 hours. If you are having thoughts of harming yourself, call Tele-MANAS on 14416 or tell someone near you now. Legal points here are general information as of 14 November 2026, not legal advice, and not yet reviewed by a lawyer.
warning.hg: Agar tum danger mein ho toh 112 par call karo; agar tum 18 se kam ho toh 1098 par. Sexual assault ke baad jaldi hospital pahuncho, kyunki HIV prevention medicine 72 ghante ke andar start karni hoti hai. Agar khud ko harm karne ke thoughts aa rahe hain, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo ya abhi apne paas ke kisi insaan ko batao. Yahan di gayi legal baatein 14 November 2026 tak ki general information hain, legal advice nahi, aur abhi kisi lawyer ne inhe review nahi kiya hai.

title.en: Coercion That Does Not Look Like Violence
title.hg: Woh Coercion jo Violence Jaisa Nahi Dikhta

subtitle.en: Pressure, stealthing, reproductive control, spiked drinks and deceit
subtitle.hg: Pressure, stealthing, reproductive control, spiked drinks aur dhoka

hook.en: No bruises, no shouting, sometimes not even a clear 'no'. Consent can still be missing.
hook.hg: Na koi bruise, na chillana, kabhi-kabhi clear 'na' bhi nahi. Phir bhi consent missing ho sakti hai.

objectives.en: Recognise pressure, stealthing, reproductive coercion, drink spiking and deceit as violations of consent.
objectives.hg: Pressure, stealthing, reproductive coercion, drink spiking aur dhoke ko consent ke violation ke roop mein pehchanna.

objectives.en: Understand how Indian law treats these situations, including where it is unclear or unequal.
objectives.hg: Samajhna ki Indian law in situations ko kaise dekhta hai, aur kahan woh unclear ya unequal hai.

objectives.en: Know the time-sensitive medical steps and support options afterwards.
objectives.hg: Jaanna ki baad mein kaun se medical steps time-sensitive hain aur support kahan milta hai.

h.en: A yes that was worn down is not consent
h.hg: Thakakar li gayi 'haan' consent nahi hai

body.en: Consent is a free choice. It is not free when it follows hours of pressure, sulking, guilt ('if you loved me'), insults, threats to leave or tell others, or control over money or housing. This happens to every gender; men are often mocked into unwanted sex because a 'real man' never refuses. It happens in marriage too, where sex is called a duty; ethically and medically, marriage is not consent. Indian criminal law still does not call a husband's forced intercourse with his adult wife rape; this exception is contested and under challenge. The domestic violence law recognises sexual abuse in marriage, and a wife can seek protection orders.
body.hg: Consent ek free choice hai. Woh free nahi rehti jab woh ghanton ke pressure, roothne, guilt ('agar tumhe mujhse pyaar hota'), insults, chhod dene ya doosron ko bata dene ki dhamki, ya paise aur rehne ki jagah par control ke baad mili ho. Yeh har gender ke saath hota hai; men ko aksar taane dekar unwanted sex ke liye majboor kiya jaata hai, kyunki 'asli mard' kabhi mana nahi karta. Yeh shaadi ke andar bhi hota hai, jahan sex ko duty bola jaata hai; ethically aur medically shaadi consent nahi hai. Indian criminal law abhi bhi husband dwara apni adult wife ke saath forced intercourse ko rape nahi kehta; yeh exception contested hai aur ise challenge kiya gaya hai.
