Domestic violence law shaadi ke andar sexual abuse ko recognise karta hai, aur wife protection orders maang sakti hai.

body.en: Stealthing is removing or damaging a condom during sex without the partner's agreement. Sex with a condom was what was agreed, so this breaks consent and risks pregnancy and infection. Indian law does not name stealthing, and how courts would treat it is not settled. Reproductive coercion is control over whether someone becomes pregnant: hiding pills, refusing or lying about contraception, pressure to conceive, or forcing someone to continue or end a pregnancy. Partners of any gender do it, and so do in-laws demanding a child or son. Under abortion law the decision belongs to the adult woman herself. A doctor can suggest contraception a partner cannot interfere with.
body.hg: Stealthing ka matlab hai sex ke dauraan partner ke agreement ke bina condom hata dena ya use damage kar dena. Haan condom ke saath sex ke liye thi, isliye yeh consent todta hai aur pregnancy aur infection ka risk paida karta hai. Indian law mein stealthing ka naam nahi hai, aur courts ise kaise treat karengi yeh settled nahi hai. Reproductive coercion ka matlab hai is par control karna ki koi pregnant ho ya nahi: pills chhupana, contraception se mana karna ya uske baare mein jhooth bolna, conceive karne ka pressure, ya kisi ko pregnancy continue karne ya khatam karne ke liye force karna. Yeh kisi bhi gender ke partners karte hain, aur bachcha ya beta maangne wale sasural wale bhi. Abortion law ke under decision adult woman ka apna hai. Doctor aisa contraception suggest kar sakta hai jisme partner interfere na kar sake.

h.en: Spiked drinks and sex by deceit
h.hg: Spiked drinks aur dhoke se sex

body.en: Drink spiking means secretly adding alcohol or a drug to someone's drink. It is done to every gender, to assault or rob, and is a crime. Signs: feeling far drunker than your drinks explain, sudden dizziness, confusion, memory gaps. Tell a trusted person, do not leave alone, and get medical help; call 112 if someone cannot be woken. Nobody who is heavily intoxicated or unconscious can consent, whoever poured the drink. Deceit undermines consent too: under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, a man who obtains sex from a woman by deceit, such as a marriage or job promise he never meant to keep, commits an offence. Deceived men are not covered.
body.hg: Drink spiking ka matlab hai kisi ki drink mein chupke se alcohol ya koi drug mila dena. Yeh har gender ke logon ke saath kiya jaata hai, assault karne ya lootne ke liye, aur yeh crime hai. Signs: jitna piya usse kahin zyada nasha feel hona, achanak chakkar, confusion, memory gaps. Kisi trusted insaan ko batao, akele mat niklo, aur medical help lo; agar kisi ko jagaya na ja sake toh 112 par call karo. Jo bahut nashe mein ya behosh hai woh consent nahi de sakta, drink chahe kisi ne bhi daali ho. Dhoka bhi consent ko kamzor karta hai: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ke under jo man kisi woman se dhoke se sex haasil karta hai, jaise shaadi ya job ka aisa promise karke jise nibhane ka uska intention hi nahi tha, woh offence karta hai. Jin men ke saath dhoka hua ho, woh isme cover nahi hote.

h.hg: Uske baad: tum kya kar sakte ho

body.en: What happened was not your fault, even if you had been drinking, were dating them or never said no aloud. Emergency contraception works up to 5 days after unprotected sex, the sooner the better, and a copper IUD is the most effective form. HIV prevention medicine (PEP) needs a doctor's assessment and must start within 72 hours. Ask about tests for other infections; some need repeating later. If you suspect spiking, go early: some substances leave the body quickly. You can get care before deciding about the police; ask the doctor what they must report. Call 181 or 14416 for support, 112 in danger, 15100 for legal advice.
body.hg: Jo hua usme tumhari galti nahi thi, tab bhi nahi jab tumne drink ki thi, tum us insaan ko date kar rahe the ya tumne bolkar 'na' kaha hi nahi. Emergency contraception unprotected sex ke 5 din baad tak kaam karta hai, jitna jaldi utna better, aur copper IUD iska sabse effective form hai. HIV prevention medicine (PEP) ke liye doctor ka assessment zaroori hai aur ise 72 ghante ke andar start karna hota hai. Doosre infections ke tests ke baare mein poocho; kuch tests baad mein repeat karne padte hain. Agar spiking ka shak hai toh jaldi jao: kuch substances body se jaldi nikal jaate hain. Police ke baare mein decide karne se pehle bhi tum care le sakte ho; doctor se pooch lo ki unhe kya report karna hota hai. Support ke liye 181 ya 14416, danger mein 112 aur legal advice ke liye 15100 par call karo.

claim.en: If they finally said yes, it was consent.
claim.hg: Agar usne finally haan bol diya, toh woh consent thi.

fact.en: A yes given to stop pressure, threats, guilt or fear is not a free choice. Consent has to be voluntary, and it can come with conditions, such as using a condom. Wearing someone down is coercion, even when no force is used.
fact.hg: Pressure, dhamki, guilt ya darr ko rokne ke liye boli gayi 'haan' free choice nahi hai. Consent voluntary honi chahiye, aur uske saath conditions ho sakti hain, jaise condom use karna. Kisi ko thaka-thakakar manwana coercion hai, chahe koi force use na hua ho.

takeaways.en: Consent must be free, informed and specific; pressure, deceit, intoxication and removing agreed protection all undermine it.
takeaways.hg: Consent free, informed aur specific honi chahiye; pressure, dhoka, nasha aur agreed protection ko hatana, yeh sab use kamzor karte hain.

takeaways.en: Controlling someone's contraception or pregnancy is abuse, and under Indian abortion law the decision belongs to the adult woman herself.
takeaways.hg: Kisi ke contraception ya pregnancy ko control karna abuse hai, aur Indian abortion law ke under decision adult woman ka apna hai.

takeaways.en: After any unwanted or unprotected sex, time matters: PEP within 72 hours and emergency contraception within 5 days.
takeaways.hg: Kisi bhi unwanted ya unprotected sex ke baad time matter karta hai: PEP 72 ghante ke andar aur emergency contraception 5 din ke andar.

activity.en: Privately, finish this sentence in your own words: 'In my relationships, a yes only counts when...'. Then note one person you could call at any hour if a night out went wrong, and save 112, 181 and 14416.
activity.hg: Privately is sentence ko apne words mein complete karo: 'Mere relationships mein haan tabhi count hoti hai jab...'. Phir ek aise insaan ka naam note karo jise tum kisi bhi time call kar sako agar koi night out bigad jaye, aur 112, 181 aur 14416 save karo.

q.en: Tanvi, 23, wakes up after a party with large memory gaps, feels unusually ill and suspects her drink was spiked. What should she do first?
q.hg: Tanvi, 23, ek party ke baad uthti hai toh use evening ka bada hissa yaad nahi hai, tabiyat unusual tarah se kharab hai aur use shak hai ki uski drink spike ki gayi thi. Use sabse pehle kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Wait a few days to see whether her memory returns
options.hg: Kuch din wait karke dekhna ki memory wapas aati hai ya nahi

options.en: Ask about it in the party group chat before doing anything else
options.hg: Kuch aur karne se pehle party ke group chat mein iske baare mein poochna

options.en: Tell a trusted person and get medical care the same day
options.hg: Kisi trusted insaan ko batana aur usi din medical care lena

options.en: Keep it to herself, because she had chosen to drink
options.hg: Baat apne tak rakhna, kyunki drink karne ka decision uska apna tha

explain.en: Early medical care matters: some substances leave the body quickly, emergency contraception works up to 5 days and HIV prevention medicine must start within 72 hours. A trusted person can help her stay safe and decide what to do next.
explain.hg: Early medical care matter karti hai: kuch substances body se jaldi nikal jaate hain, emergency contraception 5 din tak kaam karta hai aur HIV prevention medicine 72 ghante ke andar start karni hoti hai. Ek trusted insaan use safe rehne aur aage ka decision lene mein help kar sakta hai.

q.en: A partner who agreed to sex with a condom has also agreed to sex without one.
q.hg: Jis partner ne condom ke saath sex ke liye haan kaha, usne bina condom ke sex ke liye bhi haan keh diya hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Consent is specific. Removing or damaging a condom without agreement, known as stealthing, breaks the condition on which consent was given and exposes the partner to pregnancy and infection.
explain.hg: Consent specific hoti hai. Agreement ke bina condom hatana ya damage karna, jise stealthing kehte hain, us condition ko todta hai jis par consent di gayi thi aur partner ko pregnancy aur infection ke risk mein daalta hai.

warning.en: If someone is unconscious, cannot be woken or is struggling to breathe after drinking, call 112 immediately. After unprotected or unwanted sex, emergency contraception works up to 5 days and HIV prevention medicine must start within 72 hours, so see a doctor early. Legal points are general information as of 14 November 2026, not legal advice, and not yet reviewed by a lawyer; laws can change.
warning.hg: Agar drink karne ke baad koi behosh hai, jagane par nahi jaag raha ya saans lene mein dikkat hai, toh turant 112 par call karo. Unprotected ya unwanted sex ke baad emergency contraception 5 din tak kaam karta hai aur HIV prevention medicine 72 ghante ke andar start karni hoti hai, isliye jaldi doctor se milo. Legal baatein 14 November 2026 tak ki general information hain, legal advice nahi, aur abhi kisi lawyer ne inhe review nahi kiya hai; laws badal sakte hain.
